meta.provenance: Generated with CatMAP (GPLv3, SUNCAT) from its own CO_oxidation tutorial-2 input (CO_oxidation.mkm + energies.txt, resolution 15, T = 500 K, Ndigits = 1000), kept to 34 significant digits. CatMAP must be cited when used: Medford et al., Catal. Lett. 145 (2015) 794. Only the solver output needed for the comparison of Section 4 is reproduced here; CatMAP itself is not redistributed with KinSTEP.
